SELECT T1.SETTLE_SEQ_NO SETTLE_SEQ_NO, T1.SETTLE_STATUS settleStatus, T1.ORDER_ID orderId, T1.TRADE_ID tradeId, T1.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, T1.SETTLE_DATE settleDate, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId,
CASE WHEN etr.ENTRUST_CLASS = '02' THEN detail.PORTFOLIO_NAME ELSE T3.PORTFOLIO_NAME END portfolioName,
concat(concat(sci.BUSI_ACCT_NO,':'),sci.ACCT_NAME) acctNo, concat(concat(ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID,':'),ssai.SEC_ACCT_NAME) secAcctId, T1.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, T1.TRADE_PLAT tradePlat, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, CASE WHEN etr.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' THEN T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID ELSE NULL END finprodMarketId, CASE WHEN etr.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' THEN T2.FINPROD_ABBR ELSE NULL END finprodName, CASE WHEN etr.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' THEN T1.SETTLE_NUM ELSE NULL END settleNum, CASE WHEN etr.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' THEN T1.SETTLE_AMT ELSE NULL END settleAmt, etr.FINPROD_TYPE2,
CASE WHEN etr.FINPROD_TYPE2 != 'F01' THEN T1.PRIN ELSE NULL END prin, CASE WHEN etr.FINPROD_TYPE2 != 'F01' THEN T1.M_TRADE_AMT ELSE NULL END mTradeAmt, CASE WHEN etr.FINPROD_TYPE2 != 'F01' THEN T1.PLEDGE_NUMBER ELSE NULL END pledgeNumber, CASE WHEN etr.FINPROD_TYPE2 != 'F01' THEN T1.PLEDGE_ID ELSE NULL END pledgeId, CASE WHEN etr.FINPROD_TYPE2 != 'F01' THEN T1.B_PLEDGE_ID ELSE NULL END bPledgeId, CASE WHEN etr.FINPROD_TYPE2 != 'F01' THEN F1.FINPROD_ABBR ELSE NULL END pledgeName, CASE WHEN etr.FINPROD_TYPE2 != 'F01' THEN F1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID ELSE NULL END pledgeIdAbbr, CASE WHEN etr.FINPROD_TYPE2 != 'F01' THEN F2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID ELSE NULL END bPledgeIdAbbr,
T1.BUSI_TYPE busiType, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, T1.ENTRUST_NO entrustNo, T4.COUNTER_NAME counterName, T1.DEAL_NO dealNo, decode( T1.SETTLE_STATUS,'01',1,'02',3,'03',2,'04',4) sort FROM TRD_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST etr ON T1.ENTRUST_NO = etr.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T3 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID Left join MST_COUNTER_PARTY T4 ON T4.COUNTER_ID = T1.COUNTER_ID
LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci ON T1.ACCT_NO = sci.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT F1 ON T1.PLEDGE_ID = F1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT F2 ON T1.B_PLEDGE_ID = F2.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ENTRUST_ID, wm_concat ( PORTFOLIO_NAME ) PORTFOLIO_NAME FROM ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ON ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL.portfolio_id = PTL_PORTFOLIO.portfolio_id GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID ) detail ON T1.ENTRUST_NO = detail.ENTRUST_ID
AND etr.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{userName})
AND
EXISTS (select 1 from ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL det where det.ENTRUST_ID = T1.ENTRUST_NO AND det.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{item})
OR EXISTS (select 1 from ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL det where det.ENTRUST_ID = T1.ENTRUST_NO AND det.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{item})
and T1.TRADE_MARKET =#{tradeMarket}
and T1.FINPROD_ID like CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{finprodMarketId}, '%'))
and T1.SETTLE_STATUS =#{settleStatus}
and T1.BUSI_TYPE =#{busiType}
and T1.TRADE_DATE >= to_date(#{tradeDateStart}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and T1.TRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{tradeDateEnd}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and T1.SETTLE_DATE >= to_date(#{settleDateStart}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and T1.SETTLE_DATE <= to_date(#{settleDateEnd}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
order by sort,T1.UPDATE_TIME desc

SELECT T1.SEQ_NO SEQ_NO, T1.SETTLE_SEQ_NO SETTLE_SEQ_NO, T1.SETTLE_TIME SETTLE_TIME, T1.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, T1.SETTLE_NUM SETTLE_NUM, T1.SETTLE_AMT SETTLE_AMT, T4.PRIN prin, T4.M_TRADE_AMT mTradeAmt, T4.PLEDGE_NUMBER pledgeNumber, T4.PLEDGE_ID pledgeId, F1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID pledgeIdAbbr, T4.B_PLEDGE_ID bPledgeId, F2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID bPledgeIdAbbr, F1.FINPROD_ABBR pledgeName, T1.OPER_TYPE OPER_TYPE, T1.CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, T1.CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, T1.CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, T1.UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, T1.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME, T2.FINPROD_ABBR FINPROD_NAME, T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, etr.FINPROD_TYPE2,
T5.REAL_NAME operator FROM TRD_MANUAL_SETTLE_FLOW T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO T4 on T1.SETTLE_SEQ_NO = T4.SETTLE_SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST etr ON T4.ENTRUST_NO = etr.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 ON T4.ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN SYS_USER T5 ON T1.UPDATE_USER = T5.USER_NAME LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT F1 ON T4.PLEDGE_ID = F1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT F2 ON T4.B_PLEDGE_ID = F2.FINPROD_ID where T1.SETTLE_SEQ_NO = #{settleSeqNo} order by T1.SETTLE_TIME DESC
